source: game files, patch 0.5.5 (the mod table, read by RePoE); tiers from data/atlas.json
note: One row per modifier a player can meet on a waystone, a tablet or a corrupted or cleansed atlas node. pool is where it rolls; r its steps (w the waystone tiers, ls its lines, b the bonus lines it adds); tags what it does to you, from its stats (why: the line that says it); re the search fragment that lights it alone (also: what else it lights); avoid, per pool and tag, the search text for waystones or tablets without it. Written by tools/mapdanger.py; design/map-danger.md.
